fields.name: Roll
fields.evidence: Windows append bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10 (stride 0x20) stores *param_2 = the esv::roll::FinishedEvent's Roll entity (event +0x20; caller bg3.exe+0x2CF66B0 passes pcVar34-8 with pcVar34 = event+0x28; SE Roll.h FinishedEvent.Roll). Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x61BC80 is the same.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10 stores the entity of the current query row (*(view+0x40))[view+0x50] - the same entity that keys the map (get-or-add bg3.exe+0x2CF88B0 in the caller).

fields.name: SpellCheck
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10 stores the byte *param_5 = event +0x28 (SE FinishedEvent.SpellCheck, uint8_t).

fields.name: Canceled
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10 stores the byte *param_6 = event +0x29 (SE FinishedEvent.Canceled, bool).

fields.name: Results
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2CF94D0 allocates 0x40 and zeroes a HashSet (+0..+0x30) plus the value array (+0x30..+0x40). Windows esv::trap::DisarmSystem code bg3.exe+0x2CF66B0 (reaches the singleton through its storage index DAT_14638c02c) walks esv::roll::FinishedEvent arrays (stride 0x58, RollContext byte == 5), inserts the query entity as an 8-byte key (bg3.exe+0x721030), grows the value storage with 16-byte Array values (ptr, capacity, size moved per element) and appends a 0x20-byte DisarmRollResult with bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10. macOS: ls::HashMap<ID<EntityHandleTraits>, DynamicArray<esv::trap::DisarmRollResult>>::DestroyValues among the component's ops.

open_questions: Member names of esv::trap::DisarmRollResult are taken from the esv::roll::FinishedEvent members they are copied from (SE Roll.h), not from the game.
summary: Server singleton alive from the first idle level on (seen.py context: idle / act1-idle / level-change, nothing done). Belongs to esv::trap::DisarmSystem (trap disarm rolls whose result is delayed). Live: zero (never used in samples).
